scientific_integrity: The full star stationary limit has an analytic compactness, invariant-density and uniqueness proof; finite computations are supporting checks only. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive unbiased noise and continuous-time uniform imitation on unweighted stars only; no joint q-to-zero limit or generic network theorem. Prior general two-state PDMP formula covers the density integration but not this specific finite-star stationary-convergence result. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: A non-self-averaging Beta limit and a persistent density gap for the noisy voter model on stars
